calibration_basis: Shared-host Asus benchmark envelope: 4 physical cores (CPUs 0,2,4,6), CPUWeight=10000, Nice=-20, 8 GiB/no swap. Physical storage is intentionally not cgroup-throttled: OpenZFS writeback was observed to escape io.max accounting, so device cleanliness is enforced by device-scoped admission/rejection instead of a misleading per-cgroup physical-I/O limit.
